single_candidate.effect: Suppress only the existing per-layer [residency][partition] fprintf on explicitly marked serial true-decode with T=1 and no prefill request context. Keep all planning, counters, other logs, errors, GEMM/cache/precision unchanged.
single_candidate.phase_identity: Separate logging-only phase. Scheduler ModelDecodeBatchMulti B==1 and fallback ModelDecodeStep explicitly mark; prefill/continuation/unknown direct callers/B>1 retain logs.
single_candidate.startup_identity: One cached configuration line with quiet value and explicit_single_decode scope; all arms verify it.
single_candidate.rollback: quiet=0 restores old log behavior; request/global partition defaults remain0.

cold_preparation.scope: targeted readonly model-file cache advice before each performance service only

evidence_contract.quiet_decode_execution_evidence: Existing unchanged [residency][diag] per-layer forward summary, matched serially against full prefill chunks, request markers and output-minus-one decode; absence alone is not execution proof.

failure_policy.contract_identity_capacity_output_cleanu: stop dependent work, preserve all evidence; fix only a concrete identified defect with new output/identity and recheck affected items
failure_policy.valid_speed_NO_GO: continue only already frozen matrix coverage, then reject and deliver; no favorable repeats

conditional_delivery.gate: A/C history AND matrix plus quality/direct contracts PASS
conditional_delivery.scope: If triggered, freeze and execute canonical business/lifecycle checks before runtime acceptance; no default enable/merge/deploy in this phase
